items.title: Pete Barbutti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 8, 2022
items.q: this is to another agent in Spokane, a guy named John Powell. He lives up there, and I don’t know, just call him. So I called John Powell and John said you know, “They’re advertising you and everything, direct from Las Vegas.”

ctx.x: Yeah. Anyway this guy Lee Dear said, “Look, why don’t you put together the group that you want and I’ll sign the contract, you can stay here.” So I got Mike Wofford on piano, who is an internationally known jazz player, a bass player from Lake Tahoe named Chuck DeLora who is a great player, Richie Matteson, who is like a great, great jazz educator. He was at North Texas State and then he went to North Florida and won every award there and we got a girl singer who was married to Maynard Ferguson years ago, a girl…

and for some reason it popped into my head. But George Burke set it up and it was my first single ever and so I was terrified. And I said, “George I’m ashamed to tell you I don’t have the money to get to Spokane and I don’t have a car.” So he said, “Well take the bus.” I said, “Okay but it takes like a day and a half to get there on the bus.” It stopped everywhere, you know, Fresno and Elko, and so George Burke said, “Okay I’ll send you a money order.” This was before you could transfer money. And so I said,…
